name: Distinguishing Range of Universal Class
proof: Any set of r domain points yields only $2^r$ distinct restrictions, so r must be at least $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ to distinguish the n hypotheses. Conversely, encode i in $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ bits and, for each bit position, choose the domain point A consisting of precisely the indices whose bit is one. The restrictions of the $u_i$ to these points are their distinct codes.
